title: The left menu docks wherever the window is wide enough
text: The left menu no longer needs to be pinned. On a wide window it is always docked as a sidebar, also with a plan or plan doc open on the right, and the button in the top bar hides and shows it, with a panel icon that shows which it will do. On medium and small windows the button shows a menu icon instead, and the menu drops down under it.
chapters: A plan doc opens beside the sidebar
